baseline_reason: Re-recorded 2026-08-29 (second refresh that day) after three deliberate, owner-authorised changes. (1) assets/js/admin.js and pages/admin/index.html: five finished pieces whose own record read "Awaiting client review" were invisible to the client, because groupFor() called every non-approved item 'draft' and 'draft' was not in CLIENT_GROUPS - so neither renderReview() nor renderBrowse() showed them. A sixth client group, 'awaiting-review', now carries anything finished that says it is waiting on her, with its own filter chip, status option, row label and place in the review panel; genuinely mid-generation drafts are still held back. approvalFor() additionally refuses to treat an item flagged requiresIndividualApproval as covered by a standing window, matching scripts/publishing/process_manifest.js exactly, and a published page the site owner released directly now says so on its own row rather than reading as a decision of hers. (2) .github/workflows/content-publish.yml: scripts/navigation/build_internal_navigation.mjs was invoked by nothing at all, so every release left the site's internal navigation describing the library as it was before that release; the workflow now runs it immediately after a release and commits pages/ and sitemap.xml. The five previous validators of this file all still pass unchanged. Nothing in the human release gate itself was weakened: the standing window still ends 2026-12-31, routineApprovalRequired remains true, and no additional item became releasable.
